# DimensionField

## Summary

The x axis of a `ChartCard`: which column of the linked Dataset the chart groups by, and how date values bucket. `path` is a dot-path into each row (`quarter`, `orderDate`, `region.name`); `bucket` is one of `none`, `month`, `quarter`, `year` from `BUCKETS` in `../utils/chart-spec`. Bucketed axes sort chronologically; `none` keeps the order the rows arrived in, so pre-aggregated labels like "Q2 2025" never run backwards. Date-only strings are read as local dates, so a period boundary never slips one bucket early for viewers west of UTC.

Edit mode shows `path` as text and `bucket` as a row of pills; embedded shows `path by bucket`.

## Import

```js
import { DimensionField } from '../fields';
```

## Usage

```js
new ChartCard({
  dimension: new DimensionField({ path: 'orderDate', bucket: 'month' }),
});
```
